# Adiox

> Adiox is a gamified prop-trading and trading-competition platform. Users register, fund one wallet and buy access to prop-firm challenges, tournaments, trading games and a challenge simulator. Every product gives the user a trading account on the Adiox Trading Platform funded with virtual money; the system checks it against the product's rules every 1–3 seconds and closes and locks the account when a rule is broken.

## Products

- [Prop-Firm Challenges](https://adiox.io/challenges/): multi-phase evaluation per package (account size). Pass a phase by reaching the profit target and the minimum trading days; later phases are created free. Rules per phase: profit target, minimum trading days, overall loss limit (from starting balance), daily loss limit (from the day's opening balance), 15 idle days eliminates. Variants: Pay Later, First-Buyer Offer ($5,000 account for $4.95), tournament prize challenges.
- [Funded Accounts](https://adiox.io/challenges/funded-accounts/): after approval, request a payout each weekly (7-day) or monthly (30-day) cycle; the wallet is credited with profit × payout share % and the account resets.
- [Instant Funded](https://adiox.io/challenges/instant-funded/): one stage, no profit target, mandatory 2% single-trade loss limit plus daily and overall loss limits.
- [Tournaments](https://adiox.io/tournaments/): free or paid timed contests; same starting balance; qualifying players ranked by final equity; prizes by rank in cash, credit or a challenge account; rejoins; tie prizes pooled and split.
- [Trading Duels and Battles](https://adiox.io/games/): 1-vs-1 or 3+ player games with a player-set stake; winner takes the pot minus commission; duels can draw; lobbies expire after 24 hours with refunds.
- [Single Player Games](https://adiox.io/games/single-player/): Stop Loss Master, Daily Loss Defender, Overall Loss Guardian, Consistency Challenge, Precision Entry; pass to earn bonus credit.
- [Training Room](https://adiox.io/training-room/): preset or custom challenge simulators; custom fees $10 (≤30 days), $15 (≤40), $20 (≤50), $25 (>50); pass/fail only; cancel within 5 minutes for a refund.
- [Leaderboards](https://adiox.io/leaderboards/), [Rewards & Referrals](https://adiox.io/rewards/), [Trade Copier](https://adiox.io/trade-copier/) (read-only overview of copier.adiox.io), [AI Journal](https://adiox.io/ai-journal/) (coming soon).

## Money

- [Wallet & payments](https://adiox.io/wallet/): deposits by card, payment link or crypto; withdrawals to crypto or bank after KYC, $10 minimum. Checkout order: coupon → bonus credit (max 50%) → wallet → gateway (min $1). Bonus credit expires after 30 days. 100 points = $10 credit. Referral commission 10% (first 20 referrals) and 15% (21st on).
- [Pricing](https://adiox.io/pricing/): free account, no platform subscription; pay per product.

## Tournament guide

- [How Adiox tournaments work](https://tournaments.adiox.io/): single-page guide to Adiox trading tournaments — lifecycle (Coming soon → Live → Ended), rules in dollars (overall, daily, single-trade loss, max trades checked every second; min trades, target profit and equity > $0 checked at the end; 0 = rule off), competition ranking by final equity (1, 1, 3), tied cash/credit prizes pooled and split, challenge prizes to every tied player, rejoins. Shows live, upcoming and completed tournaments, with a rule checker and a leaderboard and prize simulator.

## Guides

- [Pay Later prop firm challenge](https://adiox.io/challenges/pay-later/): start a challenge for a small upfront fee; the activation fee is payable only after passing; nothing more is due if you fail.
- [How to choose the best forex prop firm](https://adiox.io/guides/best-prop-firm/): seven-question checklist (loss-limit measurement, pass condition, fees, payouts, practice, platform, rule breaches) and the route for beginners.
- [Free prop challenges and free prop accounts](https://adiox.io/guides/free-prop-challenges/): free tournaments ($0 entry) can award a free challenge account; $30 welcome credit; cheapest paid challenge $4.95.
- [How to compare forex and gold signal providers](https://adiox.io/guides/forex-signal-providers/): track record, maximum drawdown, stop loss on every signal, reward:risk, consistency. Adiox does not sell signals.
- [How to set up copy trading on MT4 and MT5](https://adiox.io/guides/copy-trading-mt4-mt5/): master and follower accounts, lot-size modes, symbol mapping, loss limits; copying with Adiox happens on copier.adiox.io.

- [How to pass a prop firm challenge](https://adiox.io/guides/how-to-pass-prop-firm-challenge/): nine steps; most failures are loss-rule breaches; at 1% risk per trade five losses in a row reach a 5% daily limit; rehearse first.
- [Daily loss limit vs max drawdown](https://adiox.io/guides/daily-loss-limit-explained/): static, daily-reset and trailing limits with $10,000 worked examples. Adiox: daily loss from the day's opening balance (midnight UTC), overall loss static from the starting balance.
